description: Live quotes for tokenized stocks/ETFs on Solana (Backed xStocks like TSLAx/SPYx, Ondo Global Markets, Remora, Backpack): FREE, read-only, no wallet. For each stock returns the on-chain DEX price, the underlying share reference price, the premium/discount % between them, 24h change, and DEX liquidity, plus the current US market session (open/closed/pre_market/after_hours). Use this over xpay_rwa_find when the user asks about stock prices or wants to buy a stock: the premium/discount and liquidity are the numbers to check before swapping into one via xpay_swap (confirm with the user first). Caveats to relay when relevant: these are issuer IOUs tracking the underlying, not brokerage shares; premiums widen while the US market is closed, and a large premium/discount on thin liquidity is not actionable.
